items.q: How is social different from Google Ads for a dermatology practice?
items.a: Google Ads captures existing demand — someone typing 'acne dermatologist near me.' Social creates demand and trust. Reels, TikToks, and provider content build the brand a patient chooses when they finally search. Best practices run both; social lowers your Google Ads CPBV over 6–12 months by warming the market.

Yes. Before-and-after and testimonial content only ships after a signed, service-specific media release. DMs are triaged through PHI-scrubbed templates — no diagnosis or treatment recommendations in DMs, only booked-consult offers. Every caption is compliance-reviewed before scheduling.

items.q: Do you shoot the content or do we?
items.a: We shoot. One in-clinic content day per month captures 3–4 weeks of Reels, static posts, provider intros, and testimonial clips. Clinics that already have a strong in-house creator can flip to a hybrid model — we edit, script, and publish their raw footage.
90 days. Social compounds — 30 days isn't enough to read signal. After the initial 90-day sprint we move to a rolling monthly retainer you can cancel with 30 days' notice.

items.q: Do you manage paid social ads too?
items.a: Yes. Meta and TikTok ad campaigns are included in the growth tier — top-performing organic posts get amplified, and we run dedicated lead-gen campaigns priced on cost-per-booked-consult, not cost-per-lead.
Yes — we run per-location content calendars off a single brand system, with location-tagged posts, geo-targeted paid campaigns, and per-location reporting on one dashboard.
